overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 64.93% annualised against 20.69% volatility (Sharpe 2.31) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 35.5%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.19% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 2.68% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -12.11%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.
